sam: Quick sync - I'm experimenting with an annotation-index compaction so loaders can fast-scan warmup hints without fetching full sidecars. Short thread.

lina: How's this different from the per-shard blob/fingerprint idea?

sam: Instead of full per-shard blobs everywhere, we maintain a compact index file (annotations.idx) that maps shard -> short fingerprint + a tiny delta for hot layers. Loaders can list the index and only fetch blobs when needed.

omar: That should cut list+head costs a lot. What's in the delta?

sam: Delta fields: prefetch_tier (hot/warm/cold), layer_delta (0-3 small ints comma-separated) and an epoch counter. Keep each entry under 64 bytes. Full blob still exists for debugging and optional signing.

kai: Do we normalize key names? We should define canonical key set otherwise the index is useless.

sam: Yes canonical keys: v, shard, tier, layer_hint, src_ref, prod, epoch. Index uses fingerprint = sha256(compact_blob) truncated to 12 hex chars. Fingerprint is stable across producers if they produce canonical blobs.

loader-bot: Perf note: canary on `annot-index` branch reduced S3 LIST+GET count by ~28% for our multi-registry trace. Artifacts: ci/annot-index/summary.txt

lina: Atomicity for index writes? Race if producers update blobs but not index.
sam: Producers should write full blob then update index via atomic rename. We also plan an index version file `annotations.idx.v1` so loaders can ignore unknown layouts. Producers can write a tombstone entry with fingerprint "00" to indicate eviction.

omar: How do loaders handle inconsistency? If index points to fingerprint but blob missing, fallback to legacy heuristics and emit a metric.

kai: Security: strip any tenant-identifiable strings. Use `src_ref` opaque hash and `prod` short name. No region/az.

sam: Rollout plan: phase A: producers write index (no loader changes). phase B: loader flag to read index and fetch on-hit. phase C: flip flag. phase D: enable optional blob verification for Dedicated with sig field.

lina: We should add a compact file format checker and a small CLI tool to convert legacy manifests->index. Also include retention TTL on index entries to avoid stale hints after model rotation.

omar: I'll add metrics: `index.scan_ms`, `index.missing_blob`, `index.tombstone_hit`.

sam: I'll open a short RFC with schema, index layout example, atomic write recipe, and a migration checklist. Tagging @lina @omar @kai. Thanks.

(ends)
